commit.scope: Native immutable f64 snapshot. deep copies every payload; shared detaches actual dirty weight partitions and retains immutable topology/unchanged arrays. registered_host_payload.scope: Named immutable native snapshots retained for old-name queries; sum of array payload sizes only. Excludes host plans, labels, packets, allocator capacity and RSS. Lineage retirement concerns GPU views; host registry is O(RB) until close.

commit.gpu_maintenance: lazy on next full native query

algorithm_control_reduction.scope: multi-rank selected frontier, light frontier and minimum-bucket decisions; no GPU completion or payload lifetime boundary removed

sssp_empty_heavy.scope: partitioned gang route only; skip R compaction/count, reset, heavy traversal and exchange; retain light closure, R settlement and global minimum

metrics.exchange_sync_scope: No remote owner, halo exchange or cooperative round protocol
metrics.atomic_min_scope: Fresh single-owner IEEE FP64 distances; actual CAS frontier or unsigned IEEE minimum device delta
metrics.kernel_policy_scope: Explicit single_owner_execution supersedes requested delta/atomic/relax/control; actual parameters in execution_policy_effective
metrics.rank_timing_aggregation: max per metric across ranks; not an additive critical path
metrics.parent_topology_scope: Completed exact-parent plan borrowed from the existing four-entry numeric-plan cache only during preparation; owned copies of topology/owner/routes; exact native delta weight certification, full scan fallback on lost maximum; fresh current-identity descriptors; no new cache/index or parent chain. Copied bytes count topology numeric element payload, not allocation capacity or peak.
metrics.weight_identity_scope: F64 reuses immutable source identity; normalized F32 may hash F64; u8 exact deterministic identity is original source digest plus explicit encoding-v1, not an encoded-payload digest
metrics.weight_decode_arithmetic: Native FP64 weights and distance state; actual minimum primitive recorded in atomic_min_policy
metrics.wire_bound_filter_scope: pack candidates above (N-1)*maxW pruned identically for f64/u32 when certified; state arithmetic remains FP64
metrics.weight_encoding_time_scope: existing plan edge endpoint/finite validation fused with exact-domain certification and encoding; nested in host-plan cold preparation
metrics.weight_storage_scope: resident edge weights only; original loader/host-plan FP64 input retained; no claim about total device peak or input-file compression
metrics.descriptor_build_timing_scope: nested in host_plan on builder only; warm hit builds zero descriptors
metrics.host_retained_bytes_scope: current cached plan numeric vector capacities including prepared descriptors; excludes native graph, packet vectors, other plans, transient closures, strings and allocator overhead; not RSS/peak
metrics.single_owner_execution_time_scope: worker wall around borrowed-engine call including structure check/control copies/checkpoint completion; excludes scratch allocation and full output gather; nested in cooperative_gang
metrics.single_owner_workspace_scope: Native workspace-owned DeviceAllocation; included in capacity/inventory/release; no private allocator, graph copy, output alias or answer cache
metrics.single_owner_distance_contract: finite nonnegative FP64 inputs; IEEE +inf unreachable and unrepresentable path sums; full fresh distances every call
metrics.numeric_distance_semantics: nonnegative binary64 rounded additions; +inf for unreachable or unrepresentable path sums

resource_management.budget_scope: Completed-query retained BFS/PR/SSSP/WCC native allocations and shared catalog; excludes transient construction peak and total CUDA process memory
resource_management.accounting_contract: Fresh full inventory per query; exact native receipts and closure predictions; exclusive session lock

native_dynamic_patch.scope: Actual native contiguous weight arrays; full WPR and SSSP kernels. Source strength recomputed by original host preparation. No cross-device shared allocation or shared-indirect execution.
native_dynamic_patch.host_diff_scope: Full host comparison unless native-generated SSSP exact-base packet applies; PR retains full host discovery. All incurred work charged inside query.
native_dynamic_patch.device_patch_scope: Sparse CUDA scatter and actual H2D/D2D bytes; retained inventory excludes transient packet allocation
native_dynamic_patch.snapshot_scope: Old host snapshots remain readable; unrelated graph families use the ordinary retention budget; released same-family GPU views may require rebuilding

metrics.host_halo_pinned_scope: Retained host pinned owned/halo buffers, capacity reused by device group under query mutex. GPU-NUMA allocation with calling mask restored. Required is current values; live/capacity include unused retained capacity. Preparation peak counts explicit pinned allocation sizes, excludes CUDA metadata/output/NCCL buffers.
metrics.host_halo_thread_observation_scope: Last iteration CPU masks; actual width and affinity errors checked every iteration. Sum per-rank requested width is 16; phase durations overlap across ranks.
metrics.nccl_sparse_scope: call mode creates a CPU transpose and two int32 GPU maps plus f64 send buffer per call. retained mode keeps the immutable host plan under the full snapshot/view key, maps under the PR view owner, and mutable send capacity under the exclusive per_worker workspace lease; active leases use a transient workspace. Retained maps/workspace appear in unique-allocation inventory and ordinary eviction/close. New/reused capacities and actual H2D are separate. No cross-weight-generation sharing claim. NCCL writes existing halo slots directly. Logical send volume is 8H per round, not PCIe traffic. Sizes exclude NCCL internals/allocator backing/process VRAM; retained budget is not a total VRAM hard cap.
metrics.nccl_halo_buffer_scope: All-gather receive scratch and sparse call-mode maps/send values are query-local and extra to retained inventory. Sparse retained-mode maps and mutable send capacity belong to view/workspace owners, are included in unique-allocation inventory, and release at idle eviction/close. Current view/workspace-plus-query-local bytes never double count retained maps/send. Explicit capacities exclude NCCL internal scratch, allocator backing and total physical VRAM peak.
metrics.communication_bytes_scope: Algorithm payload accounting; NCCL remote logical delivery includes padding only for equal-stride AllGather; variable gather publishes all actual owned values to all ranks; sparse halo sends only requested halo values. These are not physical wire/PCIe bytes. NCCL may internally stage through host. Our explicit owned-D2H/CPU-halo-gather/H2D path is bypassed only when nccl_halo_active.
metrics.device_projection_byte_scope: Referenced current views/workspaces; omitted IDs/owners counted from actual null device pointers. Excludes separately retained states/catalog entries, runtime/NCCL and transient preparation; not physical VRAM peak or actual DMA traffic avoided on a cache hit.
metrics.device_processing_timing_domain: legacy per-rank kernel-event plus communication-wall sum

cooperative_lifecycle_seconds.time_origin: cooperative execution begin; per-rank offsets share the caller steady clock
